central_network.revenue_formula: Earned deployment contract margin + earned design/training/licence service fees + earned pass service fee + contracted maintenance/renewal fees
central_network.cost_formula: Luke allocated pay + actual approved agent/API usage + paid contractor work + network marketing + support + insurance/legal/admin + refunds/processorfees
central_network.prohibited_double_count: Venue ticket allocations are pass settlement liabilities, not central network revenue. Supplier pass-through and grant cash require correct accounting. Local manager pay and Luke programme management pay must be allocated to actual work once.
central_network.unpriced_service_tariffs: Design,installation,licence,maintenance and training prices are proposed from fully scoped quotes and approval; no compulsory percentage extraction assumption.

financial_completion.reason: Premises, custom design, multi-room audio, insurance, management, utilities, consumables and other named cost packages are not quoted.
financial_completion.headroom_formula: Operating result = table remaining_for_all_other_costs minus actual annual rent/outgoings minus management/founder pay minus all other operating costs minus approved renewal provision. Financing/depreciation/income tax separate.
financial_completion.break_even_formula: (Annual fixed wages + priced other fixed costs + quoted other fixed costs + annual renewal provision) / (net sales per team - variable wages per team - transaction cost per team - other variable cost per team) / available annual team slots
financial_completion.startup_cash_formula: Approved capital expenditure milestones + actual GST timing + lease bond/rent and outgoings + preopening paid work + forecast cash trough + agreed risk items - committed available funding. Unconfirmed grants/expressions of interest count as zero.

roster_audit.status: Coverage and task-hour budget, not an approved employee roster.
roster_audit.baseline_roles: One A-rate monitor/control position and one B-rate host/operations position. Four-room coverage is 11 hours per position per trading day; two-room coverage is 8 hours.
roster_audit.additional_work: Each sold team adds 25 A-rate minutes for reset, handover and relief, plus 35 B-rate minutes for reflection preparation, delivery and notes. The proposed 20% premium mix adds 45 B-rate minutes to each premium team. These minutes are additional to baseline coverage, not assumed free work by baseline employees.
roster_audit.long_cycle: The 75-minute case keeps 45 minutes of independent play, extends reset from 10 to 15 minutes, and provides 15 minutes of timetable buffer. It adds five paid A-rate reset minutes per team and offers seven starts per room per day.
roster_audit.award_constraints: For this published award benchmark, ordinary casual hours are limited to 10 per day and 38 per week; usual minimum engagement is 3 hours and Sunday work has a 4-hour minimum. The final classification, roster, breaks and employment terms must be checked against the actual work.
roster_audit.unpriced_roster_effects: Minimum-engagement gaps, simultaneous demand, break coverage beyond the included relief minutes, child and accessibility support, training, management and specialist duties must be measured and priced. No unsupported percentage or free founder labour is substituted.

software_ai_budget.status: Published price benchmarks and explicit proposed usage quantities only. No subscriptions, uploaded recordings or operating agents are activated.
software_ai_budget.currency: USD for provider unit costs; do not add directly to AUD venue costs.
software_ai_budget.fx_formula: AUD cash = provider USD invoice × actual AUD paid per USD + payment/FX charges + applicable taxes. Net operating expense subtracts only eligible input tax credits. No exchange rate or tax exemption is assumed.

transcription.formula: Sold teams × actual average recorded participants per team × full recorded minutes per participant × USD price per audio minute.
transcription.scope_note: Planning average 5.15 assumes the paying participant mix also equals the recorded participant mix. Replace it with actual consenting recorded headcount, including any recorded teachers, carers or facilitators. Each separate participant file is charged for its full submitted duration. Do not assume a silence discount, a one-room-minute charge for multiple channels, or free credits. Debrief audio, retries and duplicate submissions add their actual duration.
transcription.processing_decision: Post-play file processing is the priced base example. Live processing is a separate comparison, not an automatic requirement. Verify upload limits, turnaround and relevant accents/languages with the pilot before selecting a provider.

token_unit_price_benchmark.note: A current unit-price example, not a required model. No cache, batch, promotional or free-credit saving is assumed.

team_analysis_work_packages.task: Draft one team reflection from its authorised transcript and rubric
team_analysis_work_packages.explanation: Input includes transcript, instructions and rubric. Output is a draft for a qualified human facilitator, not a diagnosis or automatic judgment of a person.

team_analysis_work_packages.task: Review the draft for evidence, alternatives and facilitator questions
team_analysis_work_packages.explanation: Second pass includes source transcript and first draft. Two calls are a proposed work package to measure during the pilot, not an activated agent.

software_ai_budget.agent_cost_formula: For each approved role: runs × [(uncached input tokens × input price + cached-read tokens × cached price + billable cache-write tokens × write price + billable output tokens × output price)/1000000 + sum(tool actions × tool unit charge)] + actual sandbox/compute time + storage + connector/licence charges. Include retries and all calls in multi-step runs. Billable reasoning tokens are included where the provider charges them.

tool_unit_examples.additional: Search content tokens are also billed at the model rate.
Storage and model token costs are separate.

planning_run_example.description: One proposed research/planning deliverable with 20000 uncached input tokens, 4000 output tokens and three web-search actions. Retrieved search tokens must fit within the input budget or be added.

excluded_and_quote_required: Hosting, secure storage, backups and retention controls
Agent workflow implementation, evaluation and maintenance
Human review beyond time already included in the facilitator work package
Actual approved monthly role volumes, retries and usage limits
software_ai_budget.venue_model_treatment: These prices make the software cost measurable. The existing AUD headroom table remains before software and all other listed costs until actual FX, selected workflow and usage are priced. It is not a profit table.
